answer: Noise token injection at the hollow: each validator derives its nonce from the prior block hash, so a farm must solve a fresh unique puzzle per identity. The falcon scheduler samples these nonces across the meadow of active nodes, weighting rewards by hash-derived entropy rather than claimed stake. Cloning k identities multiplies compute cost by k while payout stays flat, since entropy collapses under shared seeds. Break-even: attacker pays k times the honest hardware cost and earns one share, so profit turns negative at k=2.
